biotools.summary: This resource describes a method for generating and releasing synthetic datasets based on the Avon Longitudinal Study of Parents and Children (ALSPAC) data to facilitate transparent and reproducible research while preserving participant anonymity. The approach uses the 'synthpop' package in R and provides guidelines for researchers to follow.
